case_number: Criminal Appeal No. 1105 of 2010 and Criminal Appeal No. 1128 of 2010

parties.petitioner: Md. Jabbar Ali & Ors. and Md. Ajmot Ali

summary: The appeals challenged the Gauhati High Court's affirmation of convictions under Sections 302/149, 148, 323, 324, and 447 IPC stemming from a violent land dispute where an unlawful assembly attacked individuals, resulting in one death. The conviction of multiple accused, including life sentences for some, was based on credible eyewitness and medical evidence corroborating prosecution claims. The Supreme Court upheld the convictions, finding the evidence cogent and consistent with the application of Section 149 IPC, despite minor discrepancies in testimonies.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 323 IPC read with Section 149 IPC
Section 447 IPC read with Section 149 IPC
Section 324 IPC read with Section 149 IPC
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; conviction and sentence confirmed.
